description: Ask the user blocking multiple-choice questions through MCP form elicitation. Use this for SynaBun choices in Codex Default mode. If the result reports supported=false, ask the same numbered choices once in plain text and wait; do not call another question tool.

questions.description: One to three blocking multiple-choice questions. Each question must have two to four options; set multiSelect to allow more than one selection.

multiSelect.description: Allow more than one option in this question.
